name: zc_streaming_why

tests.name: the world is not held in a handful of actors too big to page

detail.note: World Partition pages by ACTOR using its bounds. An actor whose instanced component spans more than a cell is inside every cell it touches and can never leave residency. If most of the world's instances live in such actors, no grid setting can make it stream and the fix is to split the components by tile at build time.

tests.name: actors are marked as spatially loaded

detail.note: an actor with is_spatially_loaded false is pinned into the always-loaded set whatever its size, which is the other way a world ends up fully resident
